title: Rediscover Vietnam Honeymoon Tour
alt: Boat on the Thu Bon river at Hoi An in the evening light
transport: Two domestic flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Hanoi
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel on the edge of the old quarter

activities.name: Hanoi half day city tour
activities.description: The Ho Chi Minh mausoleum and the one pillar pagoda, the Temple of Literature and the lanes of the old quarter with a guide.

activities.name: Old quarter cycling tour
activities.description: An easy ride through the old quarter on bicycles, down the guild streets and out along the edge of Hoan Kiem lake.

program.name: Hanoi
program.description: Two nights at a four star hotel by the old quarter, with a guided half day and a cycle ride through the guild streets.

stops.name: Halong Bay
stops.accom: 1 night · All meals · Cabin with a window · 3★ · Timber cruise boat moored among the karsts overnight

activities.name: Halong Bay overnight cruise
activities.description: A shared cruise out among the limestone islands, with lunch and dinner on board and a night moored in a quiet bay.

program.name: Halong Bay
program.description: A night on the water among the limestone islands, with all meals served on board.

stops.name: Da Nang
stops.subtitle: Da Nang and Hoi An
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast and dinner · Standard room · 3★ · Simple hotel a few streets back from My Khe beach

activities.name: Surprise Cave on Bo Hon island
activities.description: A morning climb into the Surprise Cave, three great chambers of stalactites above the water, before the boat turns back.

activities.name: Hoi An with a Thu Bon river boat ride
activities.match: Hoi An Day Tour from Da Nang with Thu Bon River
activities.description: A day in the old trading town with the Japanese bridge and the merchant houses, and a boat out onto the Thu Bon river as the lanterns come on.

program.name: Da Nang
program.description: The flight to the central coast for two nights near the beach, with a full day in Hoi An and a river boat ride.

stops.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stops.subtitle: Saigon, Cu Chi and the Mekong
stops.hotel: Avanti Saigon Hotel, Ho Chi Minh
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Small hotel in District 1, a short walk from the opera house

activities.name: Cu Chi tunnels half day tour
activities.match: Cu Chi Tunnel Half Day Tour
activities.description: The tunnel network north west of the city, with the trapdoors, the kitchens and a crawl through a widened section of the original shafts.

activities.name: Saigon city tour
activities.description: The Reunification Palace, the old post office and Notre Dame cathedral, then the war remnants museum and the Ben Thanh market.

activities.name: Mekong Delta day tour
activities.description: South to My Tho for a boat into the coconut creeks, a sampan through the palms, and the workshops where they make coconut candy.

program.name: Ho Chi Minh City
program.description: Three nights in District 1, with the Cu Chi tunnels, a city tour and a full day in the Mekong Delta.

day_titles.2: Hanoi tour and a cycle ride
day_titles.7: Cu Chi tunnels and the city

1: Arrival at Noi Bai airport and transfer to your hotel
Check in on the edge of the old quarter
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: an evening walk around Hoan Kiem lake
2: Breakfast, then a guided half day of the city
The mausoleum, the one pillar pagoda and the Temple of Literature
An easy cycle ride through the guild streets
3: Breakfast and check out, then east towards the coast
Board your cruise boat in the early afternoon
A night moored among the limestone islands
4: Breakfast on board, then the climb into the Surprise Cave
Back to the pier and on to Hanoi airport
Check in near the beach, evening free
5: Breakfast, then south to Hoi An for the day
The Japanese bridge and the merchant houses
A boat out onto the Thu Bon river
The lanterns coming on as you head back
6: Breakfast and check out, then the flight south
Rest of the day free in the city
Optional: the rooftop bars on Nguyen Hue
7: Breakfast, then north west to Cu Chi
The tunnels, the trapdoors and the kitchens
Back in the city for the palace and the cathedral
The war remnants museum and Ben Thanh market
8: Breakfast, then south into the delta
A boat through the coconut creeks at My Tho
A sampan ride under the palms
The coconut candy workshops, then back to the city
9: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Tan Son Nhat for your flight home

expert.name: Riya
expert.quote: Hoi An by boat as the lanterns come on is the evening couples remember from this one.
expert.tip: Ask for a river side table in Hoi An after the boat. The old town empties out by nine and it is yours.

summary: Nine days for two: two nights at a four star hotel in Hanoi with a guided half day and a cycle ride, an overnight cruise in Halong Bay, two nights on the central coast with Hoi An and a Thu Bon river boat ride, then three in Saigon with the Cu Chi tunnels, a city tour and the Mekong Delta.
included: Included: 8 nights with breakfast daily, dinner at the Da Nang hotel and all meals on the cruise boat; two domestic flights; private transfers throughout; a guided half day tour of Hanoi; an old quarter cycling tour; a shared overnight cruise in Halong Bay with the Surprise Cave; a Hoi An day tour with a Thu Bon river boat ride; the Cu Chi tunnels half day tour; a Saigon city tour; a Mekong Delta day tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Vietnam visa fees; lunches other than on the cruise; travel insurance; personal expenses.
